usedFor: Judge.me holds product reviews, and Gtwy sends each “New Review” to an AI agent through “Call AI Agent Instantly”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Review” in Judge.me, then “Call AI Agent Instantly” in Gtwy

watchOut: “Call AI Agent Instantly” needs you to pick the AI agent, and “Updated Review” fires on each edit.
